client_req_id.description: The client_req_id of the original Provision Validators request for which the response is returned.

staking_ref_id.description: A unique reference ID generated by the staking infrastructure for the staking request.

withdrawal_address.description: The specified address to which funds will be withdrawn, as mentioned in the staking request.

fee_recipient_address.description: The fee recipient address that receives Execution Layer fees, as mentioned in the staking request.

region.description:
The geographic region where the validator will be created. Supported values are;
- US
- EU
- KR

provisioned_at.description: The date and time when the validator was provisioned by the staking infrastructure.

data.description: A block that contains validator batches. Each batch includes details of 100 validators and the associated funding transaction.

BatchData.title: Staking Response Batch

deposit_data.description: An array of validator details in this batch.

BatchData.description: A block that contains validator batches. Each batch includes details of 250 validators and the associated funding transaction.

DepositData.title: Staking Response Batch Deposit Data
DepositData.description: An array of validator details in this batch.

amount.description: The amount of ETH in GWEI required to be deposited.

withdrawal_credentials.description: Withdrawal credentials for the validator funds to be withdrawn upon exit.

signature.description: A “proof of possession” which signs over pubkey, withdrawal_credentials, and amount using the validator private key.

deposit_data_root.description: Merkle root hash of the deposit data.

deposit_message_root.description: Merkle root hash of the deposit message.

DepositTransaction.title: Staking Response Batch Deposit Transaction
DepositTransaction.description: The JSON object that contains the funding transaction details of all validators belonging to this batch.

deposit_amount_wei.description: The total amount of ETH to be staked for the batch in WEI.

contract_call_data.description: Encoded function call data to be broadcasted to the Batch Deposit Contract.
